authority: User approved small-pilot evaluation, phase diagnosis and evidence-led iteration plan
directions: All objectives minimized; HV higher, IGDplus and IGD lower
platform: All search, decoder QA, statistics and plots on Linux; Windows development and results inspection only
anchor: Frozen complete SHARE_CTX_GOM; no default-mainline promotion
normalization: Existing frozen instance scales; never fit new bounds to observed outcomes

distance.reference: Common nondominated union of every preregistered method/seed final front within an instance and batch
distance.crossBatch: Recompute all compared runs using one common reference; do not append old IGD numbers

coverage: Exact weak dominance; equality included; deduplicated vector counts and both denominators; directions not complementary
physicalExtremes: Full actual objective vectors for each objective minimum; never combine extrema from distinct solutions

eaf.threeSeeds: Individual fronts, paired raw values, medians, ranges and improvement counts
eaf.conditionalSlices: Common reference third-axis linear q25/q50/q75, reused identically for all methods
eaf.interpretation: Projection does not imply three-objective dominance

tier1.efficiencyCandidate: Quality essentially unchanged and complete cost reduced by at least10%; then require true TIME_LIMIT
tier1.extension: At most two additional preregistered seeds with unchanged algorithm for inconclusive/tradeoff cases
tier1.insufficientActivation: Budget did not adequately test the mechanism, not proof of no value

tier2.development: Both development instances, five seeds each
tier2.validation: One qualified held-out structural instance selected by outcome-independent fixed rotation, five seeds
tier2.reuse: Only identical platform, source, inputs, seed, budget and accounting; changed kernel requires matched control rerun
tier2.timeBudget: Per-instance median runtime of preregistered Linux matched NSGA-II500k; freeze before candidate TIME runs

attribution.sharing: Nested source within its actual phase; never an additional summand
attribution.interpretation: Descriptive chronological provenance, not causal contribution percentage
attribution.ablation: Same total budget deletion/replacement includes budget redistribution effects

iteration: One registered hypothesis per round; consolidate after three new hypotheses; preserve failures and remove unsupported complexity
frozenHistory: Append interpretation without overwriting original results or prior stopping decisions
